notes_for_editor: Only two real sources. The 2007 removal rests on one line in the A-Z list ('standing 2007- removed ranger tower'), which is ambiguous; FFLA gives status only. No build year found. The Virginia Birch Knob (us-va-birch-knob, Dickenson County) is a different site and search results mixed the two; nothing from it is used. No staffing, access or site-today data. Record height_m 30.5 overstates the 'under 100-foot' description. Two guessed kjackson.us pages for Birch Knob returned 404.
